name: @abernier/skills
description: Toolchain for the plugin's own scripts. The plugin itself installs nothing.

scripts.lint: shellcheck --severity=warning scripts/branchstat.sh scripts/branchstat.test.sh scripts/release-tag.sh scripts/_bench-common.sh scripts/_bench-common.test.sh scripts/_bench-config.sh scripts/lgtm-perf.sh scripts/profiler.sh scripts/tracerbench.sh
scripts.test: bash scripts/branchstat.test.sh && bash scripts/_bench-common.test.sh && vitest run
scripts.lgtm: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && echo 'LGTM!'
